scope: Live host plane, read-only apart from the preceding hook install. Re-run at 08:48:29Z after `sudo install -m 0755` of the WI-10006520-revised hook into both /etc/kernel hook directories (08:47Z); it supersedes the 07:08:16Z run, whose byte-identity claim referred to the pre-revision hook blob ce22765d. Does not install a new kernel, so the hook's rebuild path is exercised only via run-parts selection plus byte identity with the committed source (the hook's own behaviour, including the new missing-module FAILED branch, is covered by apps/operator/scripts/__tests__/vboxdrv-rebuild-kernel-hook.integration.test.ts). The committed transcript is the probe's stdout with trailing spaces stripped from five lines by the editor; no value differs.
oracle: Independent of the repair: dpkg-query, uname, modinfo, lsmod, sha256sum/cmp against the committed repo hook, and run-parts --test.
